name: pi-opencode-go-cache
description: Brings OpenCode CLI–equivalent prompt caching to Pi for the OpenCode Go provider (kimi, deepseek, mimo, qwen, minimax). Sets prompt_cache_key, 24h retention, and Anthropic-style cache_control markers on every request.
